verdict.rationale: Omnara's changelog says users can choose which agent actions need approval. That is a direct form of controlling what an agent does without manual confirmation. However, the evidence is a single changelog line and never describes tiered or graded autonomy levels. User/API-key roles (gh-1) govern people's access, not agent autonomy, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented tiered autonomy levels or presets, dedicated docs on approval policy configuration (per-tool or per-project scope), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can set tiered autonomy levels controlling what an agent can do without manual confirmation

citations.quote: You can decide which actions need approval, and agents can pause to ask questions when they need your input.
